concerns: The boss terminal's screen is entirely unlit — boxable and unambiguous as an object, but it does not draw the eye the way a glowing screen would, and if the cinemagraph phase wants a screen-flicker beat there is nothing lit to flicker. The luggage tag is the smallest hotspot target in the room at roughly 160×130 px and sits at the right corner of the bench, some distance from the terminal; the box will need to be drawn generously. The gala invitation is propped on a low plinth beneath the wall keypad rather than literally leaning against it, which still reads correctly but is a slightly looser pairing than the spec's wording. Box fronts and the invitation carry faint pseudo-engraving that is illegible at native resolution but is worth Lucas's eye at full size in case any of it resolves into glyphs.
reason: It is the only candidate and it passes on every gate that matters — all five checklist objects depicted, well-formed and correctly placed, both doors readable as real passages on the right bearings, and a genuinely clean plain-steel seam — so its remaining faults are cosmetic and cheaper to live with than a re-generation that would put the seam and the open box row back at risk.
